_meta.note: Two deliverables from the review discussion. (XR) A worked end-to-end how-to tying the cross-model distinct-actor refuter (#1) to the research adapter (#2): a doer builds a grounded writeup (source→stamp→ground) and a DISTINCT local model (Ollama) runs the refutation seeded by `hb-audit --questions`, with distinct-actor provenance. It composes ALREADY-PROVEN mechanisms (cross-model-refuter.sh T73, ground-check.sh T110, --questions T104), so it's a worked/decision guide gated by prose-integrity + referencing the real wired proofs — honest that it verifies grounding-not-truth and that a second model 'catches more' is model-dependent, not guaranteed. (PH) A blocking pre-PUSH git hook as a BOOTSTRAP FEATURE, both runtimes: whenever a HeartBeat project is bootstrapped (node bootstrap.sh AND python `hb init`), install a non-destructive `.git/hooks/pre-push` that runs `gate.sh --all` (re-verify every gate, read-only) and BLOCKS the push (exit 1) on any failing gate. Pre-push (not pre-commit) avoids colliding with HeartBeat's per-gate auto-commits. Mirrors the existing rot pre-commit hook's pattern (install only if absent → never clobber; bypass via HB_NO_HOOK or `git push --no-verify`). The hook script is runtime-specific (each calls its own gate tool) so parity is BEHAVIORAL (both block identically), like PROTOCOL action-text. The pre-existing rot-hook node-only divergence is documented in parity-notes, not fixed here. Proof-driven: spec-first, gated, refuted.

phases.title: Blocking pre-push hook — a bootstrap feature (both runtimes)

tasks.title: Spec-first: behavioral proofs for the pre-push hook + its parity
tasks.description: Author RED-first. Proof docs/howto/gate-examples/pre-push-hook.sh (prints PRE-PUSH-HOOK-OK): bootstrap a temp git project via plugin/bootstrap.sh and assert (a) an executable .git/hooks/pre-push is installed; (b) it BLOCKS — with a .hb gate re-verification that FAILS, running the hook exits non-zero; (c) it ALLOWS — with gate re-verification passing, exits 0; (d) NON-DESTRUCTIVE — bootstrapping a repo that already has a .git/hooks/pre-push leaves the existing one untouched (sentinel survives); (e) SKIPPABLE — HB_NO_HOOK=1 makes the hook exit 0 without running gates. Control the block/allow outcome deterministically (e.g. a stub .hb/gate.sh exiting 1 vs 0) so the proof needs no real failing gate. Proof docs/howto/gate-examples/pre-push-hook-parity.sh (prints PRE-PUSH-PARITY-OK): a node-bootstrapped project (plugin/bootstrap.sh) AND a python-init project (PYTHONPATH=py/src python3 -m heartbeat.cli init) each install a pre-push hook that BLOCKS on a failing gate and ALLOWS on a passing one — behavioral parity (the hook body is runtime-specific by design; assert behavior, not bytes). Both proofs FAIL now (no pre-push install exists).

tasks.title: Install the blocking pre-push hook from the node bootstrap
tasks.description: Add pre-push install to plugin/bootstrap.sh, mirroring the existing rot pre-commit hook pattern (lines ~115-135): write .git/hooks/pre-push ONLY if it does not already exist (never clobber a user hook), chmod +x, and install whenever the project is a git work tree (fresh OR existing repo — not only on first git init — so existing repos get the feature), gated by the same HB_NO_HOOK / HB_NO_GIT opt-outs. The hook body: `[ -n "${HB_NO_HOOK:-}" ] && exit 0`; find the repo toplevel; guard on .hb/gate.sh existing; run `bash .hb/gate.sh --all`; on non-zero, print a clear 'HeartBeat gate guard: push blocked — a gate no longer verifies' message naming the bypass (`git push --no-verify`) and exit 1; else exit 0. Verify `gate.sh --all` is read-only and returns non-zero iff a gate fails. Make docs/howto/gate-examples/pre-push-hook.sh green; keep tests/parity.sh green.

tasks.title: Parity: install the equivalent hook from the Python scaffold

The python hook body calls the python gate re-verify (`hb gate --all` / `python3 -m heartbeat.cli gate --all --dir <toplevel>`) and blocks (exit 1) on failure — behaviorally identical to the node hook (runtime-specific body by design). Make docs/howto/gate-examples/pre-push-hook-parity.sh green.
